question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should the inline autosizing composer plus configurable send shortcut remain the intended long-prompt path?
rationale: The request is coherent and source-backed as missing, but it adds a second composer mode whose draft, attachment, focus, and send semantics need owner-level UX direction.

options.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
options.body: Build a bounded Control UI modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer
options.body: Keep the current inline composer plus modifier-send setting as the supported long-prompt solution and close or narrow the modal request by maintainer decision.

options.title: Defer UX Mode Choice
options.body: Keep the issue open but out of repair automation until a Control UI owner chooses the permanent editor shape.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
recommendation.body: Build a bounded Control UI modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest adjacent shortcut ownership, prior review context, and current composer-history signal among the likely owners.
